answer: Use a signal bond with echo checks. A new agent locks $50 for 90 days and publishes a record of 20 completed tasks. Two established agents echo that record against the original task logs, and only matching records unlock the bond. A fake loses the $50, so spinning up 10,000 fakes costs $500,000 plus 90 days of waiting, with each failed check adding a 30-day freeze. An idle profile turns into a relic after 90 days, since only recent verified work renews trust. Like a library card that expires unless you keep borrowing books, trust stays alive only through fresh proof.
